title: JPMorganChase expands DFW presence with new Collin County office
body_markdown:
Press Releases


# JPMorganChase expands DFW presence with new Collin County office


Expansion to include the hiring of more than 100 new employees to help serve the rapidly growing business community north of Dallas


FRISCO, Texas


---


August 27, 2026


JPMorganChase is building out new banking teams and leasing 41,000 square feet of space in the new Tower at Hall Park in Frisco to serve clients who live and work north of the city.


The new office at 6605 Warren Parkway


will be home to 120 JPMorganChase bankers working in the firm’s Commercial Banking, Private Bank and Select Wealth Management businesses. Those teams are scheduled to take occupancy of the new space in early 2028.


The new office will feature J.P. Morgan signage on the 16-story building, providing prominent visibility - much like the bank’s signage downtown with its offices at 1900 N Akard.


“This expansion gives us a strategic base in a rapidly growing economic hub, giving our local clients full access to everything we can do for them,” said Graham Perry, Plano and Frisco Market Executive for Commercial Banking at J.P. Morgan. “JPMorganChase has been part of Dallas-Fort Worth for more than 150 years, and this office will help us continue to support the businesses and families driving the region forward.”


The office will include a sophisticated Client Center offering a comfortable, convenient and private location for bankers to meet clients over a latte or lunch.


In addition to the Client Center, JPMorganChase’s new office will include:


- Modern, flexible workspaces designed for collaboration
- Capacity for up to 150 employees across two floors
- Access to on-site amenities, restaurants and services


“Our growing presence in Collin County shows the rising demand for wealth management and our dedication to meeting clients where they live,” said Ashley Herbst, Head of J.P. Morgan Private Bank in Dallas and Collin County. “We are hiring top talent and expanding our team to serve clients locally. As more high-net-worth households emerge here, we remain committed to guiding clients through the complexities of their wealth and helping them secure and grow their legacy.”


“Welcoming JPMorganChase to The Tower at HALL Park is a reflection of the community we are building here in Frisco,” said Craig Hall, Founder and Chairman of HALL Group. “Companies today are looking for workplace environments that attract great people, bring clients together and create a sense of community. As a longtime JPMorganChase client, I have experienced firsthand the exceptional service and expertise they provide. We are excited to see them expand their presence in North Texas and proud to welcome such a respected institution to HALL Park.”


JPMorganChase’s largest concentration of local workers is the 13,000 people who work at its Plano campus in Legacy West, which is about three miles from the Tower at Hall Park. The bank also has about 560 employees who work at 1900 N. Akard in Downtown Dallas. JPMorganChase has more than 17,000 employees in Dallas-Fort Worth and about 32,000 statewide.
